sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Price basis and surcharge clause for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for offer:70710-0. At 6.05 EUR it stands well above our current 5.45 EUR for part:370010, so we cannot simply roll over.

We rate the partnership under ctr:4600070710 and can move on terms: 60 days net and a 24-month commitment to secure your volume.

On the surcharge, with your stated 45% material share on AS-14404 we prefer no clause, or at most a 5% deadband. Your sc:70710@2026Q3 shows 88.0% OTD, so reliability matters as much as price.

Could you send a cost breakdown and any cheaper bar variants? Our counters are attached.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month agreement and accept the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause to reduce the base price. The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Our updated offer is a price of €5.66 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €5.63 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Counter-offer: base price and AS-14404 clause for part:370010
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for offer:70710-1. We value ctr:4600070710 and are prepared to commit longer if the base price reflects it.

At 5.66 EUR your offer still stands above the 5.45 EUR we pay today for part:370010, and above the 5.72 EUR second-source benchmark, so there is room.

We accept the AS-14404 clause at a 5% deadband, and offer a 36-month term to lower your risk. Our counters are attached.

Could you send the base-price breakdown behind 5.66 EUR and confirm your earliest lead time? We will review the cheaper material-grade variant with engineering.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Price basis and surcharge clause 1.4404 bar (part:370010)
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for offer:70710-2 and the delivery schedule. The base of 5.58 EUR still sits above the 5.45 EUR we pay today for part:370010, so we ask you to move once more.

For context, quote:7200008 stands at 6.06 EUR, so you are competitive; we simply see room on the base. We keep 60 days net, as under ctr:4600070710, and accept the AS-14404 clause with the 5% deadband. In return we can commit to 24 months, or 36 months for a lower base.

Please send the base-price breakdown and confirm your earliest lead time. Our counters are attached.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
